decisions.quote: Discussion Summary of Replication Attempt The current replication study did not find a condition (sleep vs. wake) by valence (neutral vs. negative) on general or specific recognition of objects. The main effect of valence on the general recognition of backgrounds showed that backgrounds in a neutral scene were better recognized than those in a negative scene, regardless of the sleep condition. Taken together, the current study failed to replicate the original result.
